title: Money Values and Transactions to RM100
introduction: Explore money values and transactions to rm100 using everyday examples.
definition: Recognise Malaysian notes and coins and combine their values. Write ringgit amounts with two decimal places; convert sen to ringgit by dividing by 100. Add, subtract, multiply and divide money amounts within RM100. Use multiplication for equal prices and division for equal sharing.

examples.question: Two RM20 notes, one RM10 note and 50 sen.
RM84 is saved equally over seven weeks. How much each week?

exercises.question: RM100 paid for RM73.50. Change RM?
Four items cost RM12.50 each. Total in RM?
Share RM96 equally among 8 children. RM each?
Three payments of RM15.50. Total in RM?
Six identical notebooks cost RM42. Cost of one in RM?

summary: Recognise Malaysian notes and coins and combine their values. Write ringgit amounts with two decimal places; convert sen to ringgit by dividing by 100. Add, subtract, multiply and divide money amounts within RM100. Use multiplication for equal prices and division for equal sharing.
